name: Virtual Volume Sculpting (Reverse Engineering)
aliases: Reverse Engineering by Virtual Volume Sculpting
Virtual Volume Sculpting for Reverse Engineering
definition: A reverse engineering methodology that generates a volume representation of a physical object by removing a virtual clay volume using a swept volume from a tracked probe, rather than digitizing the surface points directly.
summary: Virtual Volume Sculpting is a reverse engineering method that generates a volumetric representation by subtractively modeling virtual clay with a tracked probe, eliminating point cloud processing.
